useCase.query:
Add an inventory to this {{engine.id}} game. Layout: {{layout}}. Capacity: {{capacity}} slots. Starter item definitions: {{items}}.

Requirements:
- Item definitions are data: `id`, `name`, `description`, `icon` texture key or path, `stackable`, `maxStack`, `type`. Godot: a custom `ItemData` `Resource` with one `.tres` per item (or JSON); Phaser: a typed data module.
- The inventory model has no UI code: add with stacking (returns the amount that did not fit), remove, move and swap slots, count by id, and a change signal or event the UI listens to.
- UI toggled with I or Tab (and a gamepad button if one is mapped): slots with an icon placeholder and stack count, a tooltip with name and description, drag to rearrange, and use and drop actions. Game input pauses while it is open.
- World pickups that add items on contact and stay in the world if the inventory is full.
- If the project has a save system, serialize the inventory as item ids and counts through it.
- Add a check for stacking edge cases (exact fill, overflow, full inventory).

Finish by running `pixo game verify --steps check,build,run --screenshot --json`. Fix every failing step and run it again; do not re-run unchanged code. Open the screenshot and confirm the change is actually on screen with no error overlay or blank canvas. Report what passed, what failed, and what could not run.
